title: Depository Bank Charge Pass-Through on Returned Repayments — Benefit Overpayment Accounts
content:
The pass-through bank charge recovers what the Department's depository bank charges for a returned item on Benefit Overpayment Accounts, and it is added to the returned-payment fee as well.

## Schedule of bank charges

| Returned item | Bank charge added |
|---|---|
| A returned paper check or money order | USD 12.00, the paper-item bank charge |
| A returned online bank debit (online ACH) | USD 6.00, the ACH-debit bank charge |
| A card repayment (debit or credit card) reversed by the card issuer | USD 15.00, the card-chargeback bank charge |
| A return through any other channel | No bank charge |

The channel is the one recorded on the original repayment carrying the returned confirmation number: the repayment entry on the overpayment's ledger with the same confirmation number as the return being charged, which is the most recent return entry booked on the overpayment.

## Notes

- The channel is never taken from the return entry itself or from the claimant's description; it is the channel shown on the original repayment entry.
- *Hypothetical:* a return entry carries confirmation number LKP-MO-30, and the repayment entry with that number shows a money order. The bank charge added is USD 12.00.
- *Hypothetical:* the repayment entry with the returned confirmation number shows payment by card. The bank charge added is USD 15.00.
